LESSON 35 / 36 • ADDITIONAL CONCEPT
Reduced motion and user preferences
Media features such as prefers-reduced-motion let a layout respect user preferences.
Motion නිසා අපෙහසුතාවයකේ ඇති අයට reduced-motion preference එක දාන්න පුළුවන්. Decorative
animations සහ large movement අඩු කරන්න. Essential state change එක වර්ණය Jහහෝ text මගින් තවමතේ
A hover lift becomes a simple color change for reduced motion.
Read the diagram: Compare several moving positions with a single stable position.
Motion frame එJකේ element තුන් කිහිපෙයක JපෙJනනවා. Reduced-motion frame එක ස්ථාවරයි.

Expected result: The button does not move for reduced-motion users; normal interaction still
works.
Interview question: Should reduced motion remove all interaction feedback?
Answer: No. Preserve essential feedback; reduce unnecessary movement.
